title: Blind Startup Sequence (The Unguarded Storefront)
pattern: Binding network listeners and accepting external traffic before verifying that essential system resources, environment configuration keys, and database connections are accessible and validated.
why_bad: The application starts accepting user transactions immediately but fails 100% of requests because underlying directories, databases, or schemas are missing, creating a storm of failed transactions and triggering cascading downstream alerts [266, 686].
detection: Inbound network listeners starting before bootstrap validation sequences.
fix: Enforce a rigid bootstrap sanity check sequence where all necessary files, local assets, and database connections are validated, preventing the server from accepting any incoming traffic until the system is verified healthy.
